verbalization: Ergost-8(14)-en-3beta-ol is implicated in the regulation of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1 through a complex network of interactions. The evidence suggests that this compound acts as a target of Npc122363, which in turn influences the activity of sodium/potassium transporting ATPase subunits. This pathway implies that Ergost-8(14)-en-3beta-ol may modulate the function of the sodium/potassium transporter, potentially affecting the transport of organic anions across cellular membranes. The integration of these relationships highlights a possible role for Ergost-8(14)-en-3beta-ol in the broader context of ion transport and anion homeostasis, though the exact mechanism of action remains to be fully elucidated. The observed scores suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, underscoring the need for further experimental validation.
